Title: Chocolate Cake
Ingredients:
1. 3 eggs
2. 1 cup granulated sugar
3. 1 cup milk
4. ½ cup vegetable oil
5. 2 tbsp cocoa powder
6. 1 packet baking powder
7. 2 cups all-purpose flour
Steps:
1. Beat the eggs and sugar until foamy.
2. Add the milk and vegetable oil and mix.
3. Sift in the flour, cocoa powder, and baking powder.
4. Pour into a greased cake pan and bake in an oven preheated to 350°F for 35 minutes.
